command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-revocation.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 4 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger-revocation.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes
